summary: Determined whether the Interactive Workflow + Publication CLI/Transport chapter (145A-145H.5) satisfies PCAE certification requirements, per human authorization following Phase 145H.5's READY FOR CERTIFICATION verdict. Did not restate 145H.5's own conclusions: re-derived the Blocking Finding Closure Matrix directly from current source rather than trusting any phase report -- the H-1 fix (FilesystemPendingReadinessStore.find_by_session_id searching both pending and consumed/ locations), the pcae phase complete lock-ordering fix (commands/phase.py:49-101, lock release gated behind successful finalization), and identity-bound resumption enforcement (_require_bound_identity/_require_identity_claim) all re-confirmed present in current source by direct code read this phase. Ran a fresh, full chapter-scoped regression suite in this phase (not reused from 145H.5): 1234 passed, 2 failed, both failures independently confirmed environment-caused (python3 -m build unavailable) and unrelated to chapter behavior. Gave F-145G.2-1 and the docs/COMMANDS.md idempotency/replay documentation gap fresh, explicit dispositions: both independently reconfirmed still open, both Non-Blocking, both now tracked in tasks/TODO.md. Confirmed the stale duplicate tasks/TODO.md entry 145H.5 flagged was housekeeping, already resolved prior to this phase (commit dc3a460a). Confirmed via git log that no 145-series phase touched runtime-capability or authority-ownership files. Verdict: CERTIFIED WITH OBSERVATIONS. See docs/PHASE_145I_INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_CHAPTER_CERTIFICATION.md.
